sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "fielding"."player_id" AS e, "player"."bats" AS g, SUM("fielding"."po") AS m1, AVG("fielding"."a") AS m2 FROM "fielding" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "fielding"."player_id"  GROUP BY "fielding"."player_id", "player"."bats"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, (CAST(AVG("s1"."m1") AS REAL) / AVG("s1"."m2")) AS m3 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT AVG("s2"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s2"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s2"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s2"

why: total of putouts per player within player.bats (additive)
average of assists per player within player.bats
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
average of total of putouts relative to average of average of assists: both in count of player at position, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
